title: Seasonal Practice Shift Detector
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`prayer:session`), scripture readings (`scripture:reading`), fasting logs (`fasting:log`), gratitude entries (`gratitude:entry`), retreats (`retreat:event`).
app: Spiritual-practice and mindfulness logs — prayer / meditation timers, scripture-reading plans (YouVersion), fasting and gratitude journals, and retreat calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prayer:session
| eval season=case(match(strftime(_time,"%m"),"^(12|01|02)$"),"winter",match(strftime(_time,"%m"),"^(03|04|05)$"),"spring",match(strftime(_time,"%m"),"^(06|07|08)$"),"summer",1=1,"autumn")
| stats count as sessions by season practice_type
| sort season - sessions
description: Compares practice types across seasons to reveal rhythms that strengthen or fade at different times of year.
value: Seasonality often shapes spiritual energy more than we notice; naming the pattern helps us plan around it.
implementation: Bucket prayer-session events into seasons and count sessions by practice type within each season.
visualization: Grouped bar chart of practice type by season.

references.title: Greater Good Science Center — gratitude research

grandmaExplanation: It checks how your spiritual habits change with the seasons of the year.
